plantDiseasesReference.typicalSymptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings (target-like pattern) appearing first on older lower leaves.
plantDiseasesReference.organicTreatment: Remove infected lower leaves immediately; spray organic neem oil mixed with mild soap, or copper-hydroxide organic formulation.

plantDiseasesReference.typicalSymptoms: Large, dark brown water-soaked patches on leaves and stems with white fungal mold visible on the underside in humid weather.
plantDiseasesReference.organicTreatment: Apply bio-fungicides containing Bacillus subtilis, crop rotation, and avoid overhead watering.

plantDiseasesReference.typicalSymptoms: Spindle-shaped spots on leaves with reddish-brown margins and grey centers.
plantDiseasesReference.organicTreatment: Use disease-resistant varieties, optimize nitrogen levels, and treat seeds with Pseudomonas fluorescens bio-agent.

plantDiseasesReference.typicalSymptoms: Angular leaf spots restricted by veins, and blackening of branches (blackarm phase).
plantDiseasesReference.commonTreatment: Copper oxychloride spray mixed with Streptocycline.
plantDiseasesReference.organicTreatment: Seed treatment with organic neem seed kernel extract and field sanitization.

plantDiseasesReference.typicalSymptoms: Reddish discolored tissues inside split cane stems with white horizontal bands and an odor of fermented alcohol.
plantDiseasesReference.commonTreatment: Avoid planting infected setts; clean field hygiene.
plantDiseasesReference.organicTreatment: Treat seed setts with Trichoderma viride or hot water (52°C) prior to planting, and maintain proper drainage.
